journeyObjective: Enable Daniel Brooks to review his cash value points balance and instantly apply them as statement credits toward his linked card or active holiday goal.
completionDefinition: Customer views points balance, reviews tangible cash value, and initiates statement credit application or goal allocation.
episodeSketches: Episode 1: Clear display of points balance and cash equivalent value with zero gamification.
Episode 2: Transparent breakdown of active goal progress ('Holiday Spending Money') and statement credit redemption options.
Episode 3: One-touch primary action to apply statement credit or adjust automatic allocation.
